gloss: euphonic sound change (in conjugations and compounds)

definitions.gloss: euphonic change: a regular sound change made for ease of pronunciation
definitions.explanation: The set of regular sound changes Japanese makes for ease of pronunciation, above all in the て and た forms of verbs ({書|か}きて → {書|か}いて, {読|よ}みて → {読|よ}んで, {買|か}いて → {買|か}って), in numbers with counters ({一本|いっぽん}, {三本|さんぼん}), and in compounds. Traditional grammar names four kinds: イ{音便|おんびん}, {促音便|そくおんびん} (the small っ), {撥音便|はつおんびん} (ん), and ウ{音便|おんびん} (おはよう from お{早|はや}く).

examples.english: 書いて is the euphonic form of 書きて.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{促音便|そくおんびん}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{音便|おんびん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧だ。
examples.english: The reading いっぽん for 一本 is an example of the sound change that produces a small っ.

examples.japanese: {音便|おんびん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}っていれば→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧て{形|けい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: If you know the rules of euphonic change, you can form the て-form of verbs easily.

notes:
Composed of {音|おん} (sound) + ⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧ (convenience): a change made for the convenience of the speaker. The term appears in grammar books and in explanations of counters and verb forms.

TYPES:
- イ{音便|おんびん}: き, ぎ → い (⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧, ⟦{泳|およ}いで→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧)
- {促音便|そくおんびん}: ち, り, ひ → っ (⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧, ⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧; ⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧)
- {撥音便|はつおんびん}: み, び, ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ → ん (⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧, ⟦{飛|と}んで→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧, ⟦{死|し}んで→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧)
- ウ{音便|おんびん}: く → う (お⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧ → ⟦おはよう→おはよう：05205_ohayou⟧, ありがたく → ⟦ありがとう→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧)
